'''''The Bargain of Rogosh Eagle-eye''''' is a [[legend]] concerning [[Rogosh Eagle-Eye]]. It is part of ''[[The Great Hunt of the Horn]].''{{ref/book|1|17}}
{{Quote
 |quote="[[The Bargain of Rogosh Eagle-eye]]" wound its way to an end, but Thom paused only to wet his throat from a mug of ale before launching into "[[Lian's Stand]]." In turn that was followed by "[[The Fall of Aleth-Loriel]]," and "[[Gaidal Cain's Sword]]," and "[[The Last Ride of Buad of Albhain]]."
 |early_refs={{ref/book|1|17}}}}

[[Thom Merrilin]] recited it when the party visited [[The Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]]{{ref/book|1|17}} and while performing in [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|2|25}}

The legend describes Rogosh Eagle-Eye as being "famed at the court of the [[Artur Hawkwing|High King]]" and {{ref/book|1|17}} "doing homage" to [[Blaes of Matuchin]].{{ref/book|1|17}}

''The Great Hunt of the Horn'' mentions [[Dunsinin]] holding fast to a bargain struck by Rogosh Eagle-eye,{{ref/book|2|25}} probably as part of ''[[The Bargain of Rogosh Eagle-eye]]''.
